theme_overview: A strategy seated two weeks ago is losing in live trading. Looking for implementations that split the live loss into a strategy-specific residual (the gap between live fills and a backtest replayed over the same period) and the replay's own poor performance (market regime), i.e. live-versus-backtest reconciliation with slippage and fill attribution.
goal: implementation anchors for reconciling live trades against a same-period backtest replay
why_problem: a two-week live loss cannot be attributed to the strategy or to the regime without a replayed baseline
assumptions: the same period can be replayed in the backtester
live fills differ from simulated fills by slippage and timing
